# CanvasView error codes

Plugin version 0.16.0. A failed tool call returns `isError: true` with JSON text `{ error, message }`. HTTP status is what the REST API returns for the same error. Payment errors (402) also carry `reason`.

Until then only list_examples, get_example, get_kit_reference, get_skill, list_widgets, validate_canvas and get_balance work. / This account is on the waitlist. It opens once CanvasView approves it. |

## Shared state write reasons

A rejected `useSharedState` write reverts and sets `error` to one of these reasons:

`invalid_message`, `invalid_key`, `invalid_value`, `value_too_large`, `key_limit`, `state_too_large`, `rate_limit`, `read_only`, `offline`, `not_in_control`, `scope_not_found`, `undeclared_key`, `schema_mismatch`, `not_a_writer`.
